fee_notes: Full Bakery: $35,500; Express Bakery: $8,000; Concession Bakery: $5,500; Auntie Anne's Co-Branded: $71,000 ($35,500 to Auntie Anne's); Carvel Co-Branded: $71,000 ($35,500 to Carvel). VetFran discount: $20,000 for Full Bakery. During 2025, franchisees paid $1,000 to $30,500.
raw_excerpt: you must pay us an initial franchise fee (the "Initial Franchise Fee") of $35,500 for a Full Bakery, $8,000 for an Express Bakery, $5,500 for a Concession Bakery, $71,000 for an Auntie Anne's Co-Branded Bakery ($35,500 of which will be paid to Auntie Anne's), and $71,000 for a Carvel Co-Branded Bakery ($35,500 of which will be paid to Carvel).
